Required action: from inside the new worktree, run `bash scripts/deploy-harness.sh --target "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"` before any implementation edits — the workspace must have the harness deployed prior to `writing-plans`/`subagent-driven-development`.

Key safety gate: `hooks/branch-isolation-guard.sh` hard-blocks Edit/Write on a shared branch (`main`/`master` by default), so isolation (a real worktree on a dedicated branch) must exist before the first edit, not just at commit time.
